title: Two windows: the later pick on the one field wins and Parts goes
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role at {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • Two active staff members at {Location-A} have their "Sales Representative" switch on: {Sales-rep-A} and {Sales-rep-B}.
    For example: {Sales-rep-A} is ZZAUTOTEST Ann Able and {Sales-rep-B} is ZZAUTOTEST Ben Able.
  • Customer {Customer-A} has no sales representative.
    For example: {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST SSR Fleet.
  • Work order {Work-order-1} for {Customer-A} is open and not invoiced; it has one approved labor line and one part, and its one "Sales Representative" field reads {Sales-rep-A}.
    For example: {Work-order-1} is S2-40001.
  • Starting screen: {Work-order-1} is open in two windows of a desktop browser at least 1024 px wide, side by side, and both windows show the one "Sales Representative" field.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. In the first window, hover over the Sales Representative field, click the + and click "Sales Representative - Parts".
  2. In the second window, without reloading, click the Sales Representative field and pick {Sales-rep-B}.
  3. Wait until the second window's change has saved. Do not reload either window.
  4. Reload the first window.
  5. Reload the second window.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the first window shows "Sales Representative - Labor" and "Sales Representative - Parts", both reading {Sales-rep-A}.
  • Step 2: the second window's dropdown closes and its one field reads {Sales-rep-B}.
  • Step 3: once its save finishes, the second window shows what was saved: one "Sales Representative" field reading {Sales-rep-B}.
  • Step 4: the first window now shows one "Sales Representative" field reading {Sales-rep-B}; the Parts field is gone.
  • Step 5: the second window still shows one "Sales Representative" field reading {Sales-rep-B}.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 10 (19 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 20 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11266 (Story 2, Give a work order a separate Labor and Parts representative)

  • S2-E6: “When the same work order is open in two places and one adds the Parts field while the other, still showing the one field, then picks a person, the later save wins: the work order ends with the one Sales Representative field holding the person picked last, and the Parts field is gone. Each screen shows what was saved once its save finishes.”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (19 Oct 2026), read 20 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 6: “6. (a) Tab B's choice wins and the Parts field disappears: the later save wins, as everywhere else.”
